Short title and commencement

THE PAKISTAN NAVY (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1950
THE PAKISTAN NAVY (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1950
ACT No. XXIV of 1950
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gaz. of P.,1950, Pt. V, p. 52.
[30th January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the retention in service of certain persons
enrolled for service in the (The word
"Royal" omitted by A. O.,1961, Art, 2 and Sch. (with effect from 23rd
March, 1956))* Pakistan Navy
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be
called the (The
word "Royal" omitted by A. O.,1961, Art, 2 and Sch. (with effect from
23rd March, 1956))* Pakistan
Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Navy Extension of Service Act 1950
sections.description:
Extension of service where term of service has expired

THE PAKISTAN NAVY (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1950
THE PAKISTAN NAVY (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1950
ACT No. XXIV of 1950
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see
Gaz. of P.,1950, Pt. V, p. 52.
[30th January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the retention in service of certain persons
enrolled for service in the (The word
"Royal" omitted by A. O.,1961, Art, 2 and Sch. (with effect from 23rd
March, 1956))* Pakistan Navy
2. Extension of service where term of service has expired. Until
such date as may be notified in this behalf by the Central Government, any
person enrolled for service in the (The word Royal" omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch.
(with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).) * Pakistan Navy who, by reason of the expiry of the term for
which he was engaged to serve when so enrolled, is no longer liable for service
shall, notwithstanding such expiry, continue to be enrolled for service and to
be liable for service in the (The word Royal" omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch.
(with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* Pakis tan Navy until he is discharged by the order of the
Officer Com manding the (The word Royal" omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch.
(with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* Pakistan Navy:
Provided that the period for
which the service of any such person is extended under this section shall not
exceed five years from the day on which his service would otherwise have ter minated.
